name: Ring of the Cub
body:
Aura moderate evocation; CL 7th; Slot ring; Weight –

DESCRIPTION

This ring looks like a ring of the lion. Instead of granting a bonus against fear effects, the wearer has a -1 modifier against fear effects and is considered flat-footed in the first round of any combat.

This ring can only be removed by the casting of remove fear or remove curse upon it. Remove fear allows the ring to be removed but the ring and enchantment remain intact. Remove curse renders the ring non-magical.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Magic Items ring of the lion

Identification DC 32
False Identification DC 22
